The water jets have a solid, plastic-like texture rather than a particulate mist. They look like solid white ribbons attached to the nozzles, lacking the expected dispersion and transparency of high-pressure water.
The background boat appears slightly warped and melts into the horizon line. Its structure is less defined than the foreground, suggesting a depth rendering issue.
Slight softness and bleeding where the red hull meets the water, particularly around the bow wave, though some motion blur is expected.
